newsitem.title: sri lanka: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government's 1997 budget gives substantial incentives for private sector, pay hike for public servants.
Australian Foreign Minister Alexander Downer tells parliament he will not meet Tamil groups in Australia unless they condemn terrorist activities of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels.
Amparai magistrate remands priest over death of 18-year-old girl at his home.
Opposition United National Party decides to vote against 1997 budget.
Earnings of government officials, pensioners raised in 1997 budget.
